scope: Generic finite normalized real label-weight inclusion-exclusion identity: the actual admissible degree-two label sum is1−I2−I2²+I4, with I2=sum p_i² and I4=sum p_i⁴. Independent exact actual graph checks on prime Z7: all128staticlabelmaps and49orderedstartingpairs,6272samples. Steps1,3 satisfy literal source distinctness of degree0/1/2 sums modulo commutativity. Kernel-checked one-step fresh collision count448 and two-step fresh count336 yield actual PMF event rates1/14 and3/56; actual uniform sample-law pointmass factors as seven uniform vertex-label and two uniform-start factors. Uniform label coefficient3/8 matches the actual two-step rate after division by7. Steps1,2 remain distinct/nonzero but violate source degree≤2genericity; actual two-step count112/rate1/56 directly disproves the coefficient after dropping that condition. No count/probability/sourcegenericity/coefficient is assumed as a premise. Bernstein–Lange2013§§3–4 known correction credited, no novelty/source-refutation claim. Generic label identity and exact ground-group probability check do not prove the actual-group coefficient for all groups/supports, the limiting firstcollision penalty or practical keyedhash refinement. Independent native written-header check is procedural, not kernel parser/hash/execution refinement. Standard foundations/defaults, all actual enumeration by kernel-checked decisions; no holes/custom axioms/native proof evaluation/global flags/raised limits/waivers/new native cryptographic experiment/paid compute/agent upload.
